capabilities: Color folders and notes from the file explorer right-click menu
Tint rows using Obsidian's own nav-item styling so themes stay intact
Keep colors attached through renames, moves and nested folder changes
Sort the file explorer by color via a toolbar toggle or command
Clear colors or disable color sorting in settings
disambiguation: Not a note-tagging or Finder-tags tool; it only colors rows in the file explorer and stores colors in its own data.json.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Color sorting relies on internal file explorer APIs and may break after Obsidian upgrades, and may conflict with other plugins that sort or pin explorer items. Colors sync across devices only if community plugin configuration sync is enabled in Obsidian Sync settings.
intentEvidence: Color Tags is a fork of Color Marker by Central Brain Trust
motivation: The author found existing explorer-coloring plugins decorate rows with pills and borders so colored items stop looking like they belong in the list, and built this one to tint rows using Obsidian's own styling instead.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer has no built-in way to color-code folders and notes, and other coloring plugins stack CSS that changes row shape and clashes with themes.

relations.evidence: Color Tags is a fork of Color Marker by Central Brain Trust (centralbraintrust.com)

summary: File explorer plugin that colors folders and notes via the right-click menu using the macOS Finder palette plus five extra colors.
